evidence: Swap test fails: a GP surgery, a library study-room or a swimming-lane booking could use the frame unchanged with words swapped. Identity is the council name in bold body sans beside a small bin glyph (root/default/1280-light, header); one dark green on a pale grey-green ground; slots are outlined boxes with amber 'Few left' and grey 'Full' tags; the done page is two bordered cards.

Category-guess fails: a council service is predicted as a light ground, one sober green or navy accent, outlined option buttons, bordered summary cards and a footer with a phone number - which is what is here.
Similar-prompt fails: 'booking for a council sports-hall court' would produce the same slot grid, day-chip row, summary list and reference card.

Bound to the product only through content: vehicle/permit/waste choices, '20-minute slot', 'Show this at the gate', reference DR-204117. No element of the visual layer (type voice, colour anchor, signature, imagery) comes from the tip, its gate, its bays or its permits.

evidence: Clean and orderly, with a tidy green primary button and readable type, but a first-time resident sees a default form: no imagery of the centre, no colour doing work beyond the button and the amber 'Few left' tags.
Nothing on the done page makes the reference feel like the ticket to show at the gate: DR-204117 is a medium-size heading in a plain white box (done/default/375-light).
Dark theme is composed competently (root/default/1280-dark) but equally bare.
